page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9i.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance virtualized via KVM on the x86_64 architecture. It provides 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor running at a clock speed of 3.2 GHz, accompanied by 64.0 GB of system memory. This yields a 1:2 memory-to-core allocation of 2.0 GB per vCPU. The instance does not include integrated GPU accelerators.

Storage and network configurations are decoupled from local hardware resources. The instance comes with no bundled local storage, necessitating reliance on network-attached block storage for operating system and application data. External connectivity features a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The 1:2 memory-to-vCPU allocation focuses hardware expense strictly on processing capacity rather than large memory arrays or onboard NVMe controllers. Consequently, workloads with intense in-memory requirements or demanding local scratch disk needs may experience limitations. The resource profile is suited for compute-heavy batch processing, distributed worker nodes, code compilation, continuous integration pipelines, and CPU-bound application serving.
